SELECT /* LGVPAY00033.retrievePerfectActual */ r.employee_no , em.assignment_category, r.time_and_attendance_yyyymm ,SUM(DECODE(b.time_and_attendance_code,'NW',1,'PH',1,0)) perfect_work_days ,SUM(lgvpay_info_pkg.get_work_hours('LGDVN', r.employee_no, b.time_and_attendance_date, DECODE(r.time_and_attendance_code,'WH','WH','PH','PH','NW'), b.shift_type_code, b.work_hours, 'pay_perfect_hours')) as perfect_work_hours ,SUM( CASE WHEN (c.paid_days > 0 OR c.attendance_days > 0) THEN lgvpay_info_pkg.get_work_hours('LGDVN', r.employee_no, b.time_and_attendance_date, DECODE(r.time_and_attendance_code,'WH','WH','PH','PH','NW'), b.shift_type_code, b.work_hours, 'pay_perfect_hours') END) ACTUAL_HOURS ,(SUM( CASE WHEN (c.paid_days > 0 OR c.attendance_days > 0) THEN lgvpay_info_pkg.get_work_hours('LGDVN', r.employee_no, b.time_and_attendance_date, DECODE(r.time_and_attendance_code,'WH','WH','PH','PH','NW'), b.shift_type_code, b.work_hours, 'pay_perfect_hours') WHEN r.time_and_attendance_code = 'WH' THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT ar.work_hours FROM tb_att_result_n ar where ar.employee_no = r.employee_no and ar.time_and_attendance_date = b.time_and_attendance_date and ar.time_and_attendance_code != 'NN' ) END ) - 192 - (nvl(SUM(nvl(r.tardy_hours,0)) + SUM(nvl(r.going_out_hours,0)) + SUM(nvl(r.early_leave_hours,0)),0)) ) AS EXTRA_HOURS ,SUM( CASE WHEN r.shift_type_code LIKE '32%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "2S3G_OR_NOT" ,SUM( CASE WHEN r.time_attend_detail_code = #{paidLeaveDetailCode} THEN b.work_hours ELSE 0 END) PL_HOURS, nvl(SUM(nvl(r.tardy_hours,0)) + SUM(nvl(r.going_out_hours,0)) + SUM(nvl(r.early_leave_hours,0)),0) DEDUC_HOURS, SUM(CASE WHEN ((c.paid_days > 0 OR c.attendance_days > 0) AND b.shift_type_code like '%102%') THEN lgvpay_info_pkg.get_work_hours( 'LGDVN' ,r.employee_no ,b.time_and_attendance_date ,DECODE(r.time_and_attendance_code,'WH','WH','PH','PH','NW') ,b.shift_type_code ,b.work_hours ,'pay_perfect_hours') END) AS actual_hours_2S10G FROM tb_att_result_n r, tb_att_code_c c, tb_att_base_bas_n b, emp_master em WHERE r.time_and_attendance_code = c.time_and_attendance_code AND r.shift_type_code = b.shift_type_code AND r.time_and_attendance_date = b.time_and_attendance_date AND r.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND em.employee_number = r.employee_no AND em.employee_number IN ( select tpp.employee_no from tb_pay_paid_leave_n tpp where tpp.payment_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND tpp.paid_leave_detail_code = #{paidLeaveDetailCode} )
AND em.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
AND UPPER(em.full_name_local) like '%' || UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%'
GROUP BY r.employee_no, em.assignment_category, r.time_and_attendance_yyyymm
